tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are part of your school's drama club and have been assigned the role of event coordinator for an upcoming play. You need to arrange for promotional materials, such as posters and flyers, to be printed and distributed. You want to contact a local print shop to discuss this.
bullets: Describe the event and why the printing is important.
Ask about their services for printing promotional materials.
Inquire about the costs and turnaround time for printing.
tasks.subject: Printing Services for Upcoming Play
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Clark,

I am the event coordinator for our school's drama club. We will stage a play at the end of next month. The play is one of the biggest campus events of the year, and we expect several hundred students and faculty members to attend. To promote it, we need posters and flyers printed and distributed around campus.

Could you tell me whether your shop handles promotional printing for school events? We would also like to know your pricing for about fifty A2 posters and three hundred A4 flyers, as well as your turnaround time, since our publicity campaign starts in two weeks.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Alex Chen
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：活动与印刷重要性、能否做宣传印刷、价格与工期。称呼 Ms. Clark，结尾用 Best regards。
tasks.title: Printing Services

tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Professor
professor.text: Some historians believe that individuals such as political leaders or influential thinkers have a greater impact on historical progress than broader social and economic forces. Others argue that social and economic events are the primary drivers of historical change. In your opinion, which has a greater influence on shaping history: individual actions or broader social and economic forces? Why?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: Great individuals, such as political leaders or leaders of social movements, create significant changes and leave a lasting legacy.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: In my opinion, broader social and economic events are more significant in shaping history. While individuals can influence events, it is the underlying conditions and trends that drive major changes.

tasks.sample: I believe individuals and social forces work together, but social and economic forces set the stage. For example, the American civil rights movement did not succeed only because of Martin Luther King's talent; it succeeded because millions of ordinary people were ready for change and the economy and media of the time amplified their voices. Without those social forces, even the most gifted individual would have been ignored. That said, individuals matter at the decisive moment: a leader gives a movement direction and courage at critical points. Social forces create the possibility of change, while influential individuals decide its shape and timing. Neither alone is enough to drive history forward.
tasks.analysis: 需表明立场并回应对方。较好答法：社会力量提供条件，关键人物决定时机与方向，并举例。
tasks.title: The Driving Force of History
